about.title: About us
about.p1: AeroVibe wasn’t born in a meeting room. It was born out in the field. In that awkward moment when you’ve already packed everything, driven across town, and when you finally arrive… the spot wasn’t what it promised. Crosswind, power lines you never saw on the map, restrictions no one mentioned. Time wasted. Energy wasted. Inspiration gone.
about.p2: That’s when we realized something simple: flying already has enough variables — you shouldn’t have to improvise the information too.
about.p3: We’re a small team — and yes, a bit obsessive — building the platform we wished we had from the first flight. We want more signal and less noise. Real spots with real context. Media that loads fast because no one wants to wait out in the field. Stable profiles, clear metrics, and tools that help you decide before takeoff, not after.
about.p4: We believe in community over algorithms. A great spot shouldn’t get lost in an endless feed. Sharing useful information isn’t “giving away an advantage” — it raises the bar for everyone. And technology should serve the pilot, not the other way around.
about.p5: If you’ve ever been frustrated by showing up and finding out it wasn’t what it looked like, this project is yours too. If you found an incredible spot and thought “this can’t be lost”, we’re on the same side. AeroVibe is being built with real pilot feedback — flight after flight, iteration after iteration.
about.p6: We don’t want to be just another social network. We want to be the base before takeoff. The place where you plan better, discover more, and share with purpose.
about.p7: This is just the beginning. And we’re building it to use every day.

faq.title: Complete FAQs
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about accounts, spots, safety, subscriptions, and support.

items.a: AeroVibe is a platform to discover, create, and plan drone spots with real location data, optimized media, and tools designed to provide more context before flying. Content is community-generated.

items.q: Do I need an account to use AeroVibe?
items.a: You can explore public content without creating an account. To interact (create spots, comment, favorites, flight plans, or Pro features), you need to sign in.
Spots are designed to be public and collaborative within the community. Additional visibility options may be introduced in the future as the product evolves.

items.q: Does AeroVibe guarantee that a spot is safe or legal to fly?
items.a: No. AeroVibe does not replace aviation regulations or professional advice. Each pilot is responsible for checking local regulations, permits, and conditions before flying.

items.q: Does AeroVibe track my location in the background?
items.a: No. We only use location when you authorize it and when it is required for specific features, such as creating a spot or showing nearby content.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: From your profile settings, you can delete your account at any time.

items.q: What data is removed when I delete my account?
items.a: Personally identifiable data is removed. Public content may remain in anonymized form for operational and platform integrity reasons.

items.q: How do I block a user?
items.a: From a user profile, you can select the block option. Blocking restricts interactions and limits visibility according to the current platform rules.
Each spot or profile includes a report option. You can also email support@aerovibe.app for urgent situations.

items.q: What does the Pro Plan include?
items.a: The Pro Plan may include expanded limits, more hangar slots, extended forecast, and early access to premium features. Features may change as the product evolves.
Subscriptions made from the app are managed through App Store or Google Play, as applicable. Subscriptions made from the web are managed through the corresponding payment provider.

items.q: How do I restore a purchase on iOS?
items.a: You can restore purchases from the subscriptions section inside the app using your Apple ID.

items.q: Can I delete a published spot?
items.a: Yes. From the edit section, you can delete your published spots at any time.
